20pub(crate) fn has_colr_data(font: &Font, glyph: GlyphId) -> bool {
21    font.font_ref()
22        .color_glyphs()
23        .get(glyph.to_skrifa())
24        .is_some()
25}
26
27/// Draw a COLR-based glyph on a surface.
28pub(crate) fn draw_glyph(
29    font: Font,
30    context_color: rgb::Color,
31    glyph: GlyphId,
32    surface: &mut Surface,
33) -> Option<()> {
34    // Drawing COLR glyphs is a bit tricky, because it's possible that an error
35    // occurs while we are drawing, in which case we cannot revert it anymore since
36    // we already drew the instructions onto the surface. Because of this, we first
37    // convert the glyph into a more accessible bytecode representation and only
38    // if that succeeds do we iterate over the bytecode to draw onto the canvas.
39
40    let colr_glyphs = font.font_ref().color_glyphs();
41    let colr_glyph = colr_glyphs.get(glyph.to_skrifa())?;
42
43    let mut colr_canvas = ColrBuilder::new(font.clone(), context_color);
44    colr_glyph
45        .paint(font.location_ref(), &mut colr_canvas)
46        .ok()?;
47    let instructions = colr_canvas.finish()?;
48
49    surface.push_transform(&Transform::from_scale(1.0, -1.0));
50    interpret(instructions, surface);
51    surface.pop();
52
53    Some(())
54}
55
56// Interpret the glyph bytecode
57fn interpret(instructions: Vec<Instruction>, surface: &mut Surface) {
58    for instruction in instructions {
59        match instruction {
60            Instruction::Layer(blend, instructions) => {
61                surface.push_blend_mode(blend);
62                surface.push_isolated();
63                interpret(instructions, surface);
64                surface.pop();
65                surface.pop();
66            }
67            Instruction::Filled(fill, mut clips) => {
68                let filled = clips.split_off(clips.len() - 1);
69
70                let num_clips = clips.len();
71                for path in clips {
72                    surface.push_clip_path(&crate::geom::Path(path), &FillRule::NonZero);
73                }
74
75                let old_fill = surface.get_fill().cloned();
76                let old_stroke = surface.get_stroke().cloned();
77
78                surface.set_fill(Some(*fill));
79                surface.set_stroke(None);
80
81                surface.draw_path(&crate::geom::Path(filled[0].clone()));
82
83                surface.set_fill(old_fill);
84                surface.set_stroke(old_stroke);
85
86                for _ in 0..num_clips {
87                    surface.pop();
88                }
89            }
90        }
91    }
92}

94/// The context necessary for creating the bytecode of a COLR-based glyph.
95struct ColrBuilder {
96    font: Font,
97    context_color: rgb::Color,
98    clips: Vec<Vec<Path>>,
99    stack: Vec<Vec<Instruction>>,
100    layers: Vec<BlendMode>,
101    transforms: Vec<Transform>,
102    error: bool,
103}
104
105/// A bytecode instruction for drawing a COLR glyph.
106enum Instruction {
107    Layer(BlendMode, Vec<Instruction>),
108    Filled(Box<Fill>, Vec<Path>),
109}
110
111impl ColrBuilder {
112    pub fn new(font: Font, context_color: rgb::Color) -> Self {
113        Self {
114            font,
115            context_color,
116            stack: vec![vec![]],
117            transforms: vec![Transform::identity()],
118            clips: vec![vec![]],
119            layers: vec![],
120            error: false,
121        }
122    }
123
124    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Option<Vec<Instruction>> {
125        if self.error {
126            return None;
127        } else if let Some(instructions) = self.stack.pop() {
128            return Some(instructions);
129        }
130
131        None
132    }
133}
134
135impl ColrBuilder {
136    fn palette_index_to_color(
137        &self,
138        palette_index: u16,
139        alpha: f32,
140    ) -> Option<(rgb::Color, NormalizedF32)> {
141        if palette_index != u16::MAX {
142            let color = self
143                .font
144                .font_ref()
145                .cpal()
146                .ok()?
147                .color_records_array()?
148                .ok()?[palette_index as usize];
149
150            Some((
151                rgb::Color::new(color.red, color.green, color.blue),
152                NormalizedF32::new(alpha * color.alpha as f32 / 255.0)?,
153            ))
154        } else {
155            Some((self.context_color, NormalizedF32::new(alpha)?))
156        }
157    }
158
159    fn stops(&self, stops: &[ColorStop]) -> Option<Vec<Stop>> {
160        let mut converted_stops = vec![];
161
162        for stop in stops {
163            let (color, alpha) = self.palette_index_to_color(stop.palette_index, stop.alpha)?;
164
165            converted_stops.push(Stop {
166                offset: NormalizedF32::new(stop.offset)?,
167                color: color.into(),
168                opacity: alpha,
169            })
170        }
171
172        Some(converted_stops)
173    }
174}

176trait ExtendExt {
177    fn to_spread_method(&self) -> SpreadMethod;
178}
179
180impl ExtendExt for skrifa::color::Extend {
181    fn to_spread_method(&self) -> SpreadMethod {
182        match self {
183            skrifa::color::Extend::Pad => SpreadMethod::Pad,
184            skrifa::color::Extend::Repeat => SpreadMethod::Repeat,
185            skrifa::color::Extend::Reflect => SpreadMethod::Reflect,
186            skrifa::color::Extend::Unknown => SpreadMethod::Pad,
187        }
188    }
189}

191impl ColorPainter for ColrBuilder {
192    fn push_transform(&mut self, transform: skrifa::color::Transform) {
193        let Some(last_transform) = self.transforms.last() else {
194            self.error = true;
195            return;
196        };
197
198        let new_transform = last_transform.pre_concat(Transform::from_row(
199            transform.xx,
200            transform.yx,
201            transform.xy,
202            transform.yy,
203            transform.dx,
204            transform.dy,
205        ));
206        self.transforms.push(new_transform);
207    }
208
209    fn pop_transform(&mut self) {
210        let Some(_) = self.transforms.pop() else {
211            self.error = true;
212            return;
213        };
214    }
215
216    fn push_clip_glyph(&mut self, glyph_id: skrifa::GlyphId) {
217        let Some(mut old) = self.clips.last().cloned() else {
218            self.error = true;
219            return;
220        };
221
222        let mut glyph_builder = OutlineBuilder::new();
223        let outline_glyphs = self.font.outline_glyphs();
224        let Some(outline_glyph) = outline_glyphs.get(glyph_id) else {
225            self.error = true;
226            return;
227        };
228
229        let Ok(_) = outline_glyph.draw(
230            DrawSettings::unhinted(skrifa::instance::Size::unscaled(), self.font.location_ref()),
231            &mut glyph_builder,
232        ) else {
233            self.error = true;
234            return;
235        };
236
237        let Some(path) = glyph_builder
238            .finish()
239            .and_then(|p| p.transform(self.transforms.last()?.to_tsp()))
240        else {
241            self.error = true;
242            return;
243        };
244
245        old.push(path);
246
247        self.clips.push(old);
248    }
249
250    fn push_clip_box(&mut self, clip_box: BoundingBox<f32>) {
251        let Some(mut old) = self.clips.last().cloned() else {
252            self.error = true;
253            return;
254        };
255
256        let mut path_builder = PathBuilder::new();
257        path_builder.move_to(clip_box.x_min, clip_box.y_min);
258        path_builder.line_to(clip_box.x_min, clip_box.y_max);
259        path_builder.line_to(clip_box.x_max, clip_box.y_max);
260        path_builder.line_to(clip_box.x_max, clip_box.y_min);
261        path_builder.close();
262
263        let Some(path) = path_builder
264            .finish()
265            .and_then(|p| p.transform(self.transforms.last()?.to_tsp()))
266        else {
267            self.error = true;
268            return;
269        };
270        old.push(path);
271
272        self.clips.push(old);
273    }
274
275    fn pop_clip(&mut self) {
276        let Some(_) = self.clips.pop() else {
277            self.error = true;
278            return;
279        };
280    }
281
282    fn fill(&mut self, brush: Brush<'_>) {
283        if let Some(fill) = match brush {
284            Brush::Solid {
285                palette_index,
286                alpha,
287            } => {
288                let (color, alpha) = match self.palette_index_to_color(palette_index, alpha) {
289                    Some(c) => c,
290                    None => {
291                        self.error = true;
292                        return;
293                    }
294                };
295                Some(Fill {
296                    paint: color.into(),
297                    opacity: alpha,
298                    rule: Default::default(),
299                })
300            }
301            Brush::LinearGradient {
302                p0,
303                p1,
304                color_stops,
305                extend,
306            } => {
307                let stops = match self.stops(color_stops) {
308                    Some(s) => s,
309                    None => {
310                        self.error = true;
311                        return;
312                    }
313                };
314
315                let Some(transform) = self.transforms.last().copied() else {
316                    self.error = true;
317                    return;
318                };
319
320                let linear = LinearGradient {
321                    x1: p0.x,
322                    y1: p0.y,
323                    x2: p1.x,
324                    y2: p1.y,
325                    stops,
326                    spread_method: extend.to_spread_method(),
327                    transform,
328                    anti_alias: false,
329                };
330
331                Some(Fill {
332                    paint: linear.into(),
333                    opacity: NormalizedF32::ONE,
334                    rule: Default::default(),
335                })
336            }
337            Brush::RadialGradient {
338                c0,
339                r0,
340                c1,
341                r1,
342                color_stops,
343                extend,
344            } => {
345                let stops = match self.stops(color_stops) {
346                    Some(s) => s,
347                    None => {
348                        self.error = true;
349                        return;
350                    }
351                };
352
353                let Some(transform) = self.transforms.last().copied() else {
354                    self.error = true;
355                    return;
356                };
357
358                let radial = RadialGradient {
359                    fx: c0.x,
360                    fy: c0.y,
361                    fr: r0,
362                    cx: c1.x,
363                    cy: c1.y,
364                    cr: r1,
365                    stops,
366                    spread_method: extend.to_spread_method(),
367                    transform,
368                    anti_alias: false,
369                };
370
371                Some(Fill {
372                    paint: radial.into(),
373                    opacity: NormalizedF32::ONE,
374                    rule: Default::default(),
375                })
376            }
377            Brush::SweepGradient {
378                c0,
379                start_angle,
380                end_angle,
381                color_stops,
382                extend,
383            } => {
384                let stops = match self.stops(color_stops) {
385                    Some(s) => s,
386                    None => {
387                        self.error = true;
388                        return;
389                    }
390                };
391
392                let Some(mut transform) = self.transforms.last().copied() else {
393                    self.error = true;
394                    return;
395                };
396
397                // krilla sweep gradients go in a different direction than COLR, so we need
398                // to invert y-axis.
399
400                transform = transform.pre_concat(Transform::from_scale(1.0, -1.0));
401
402                let sweep = SweepGradient {
403                    cx: c0.x,
404                    cy: -c0.y,
405                    start_angle,
406                    end_angle,
407                    stops,
408                    spread_method: extend.to_spread_method(),
409                    transform,
410                    anti_alias: false,
411                };
412
413                Some(Fill {
414                    paint: sweep.into(),
415                    opacity: NormalizedF32::ONE,
416                    rule: Default::default(),
417                })
418            }
419        } {
420            // The proper implementation would be to apply all clip paths and then draw the
421            // whole "visible" area with the fill. However, this seems to produce artifacts in
422            // Google Chrome when zooming. So instead, what we do is that we apply all clip paths except
423            // for the last one, and the last one we use to actually perform the fill.
424            let Some(clips) = self.clips.last().map(|paths| paths.to_vec()) else {
425                self.error = true;
426                return;
427            };
428
429            let Some(stack) = self.stack.last_mut() else {
430                self.error = true;
431                return;
432            };
433
434            stack.push(Instruction::Filled(Box::new(fill), clips));
435        }
436    }
437
438    fn push_layer(&mut self, composite_mode: CompositeMode) {
439        let mode = match composite_mode {
440            CompositeMode::SrcOver => BlendMode::Normal,
441            CompositeMode::Screen => BlendMode::Screen,
442            CompositeMode::Overlay => BlendMode::Overlay,
443            CompositeMode::Darken => BlendMode::Darken,
444            CompositeMode::Lighten => BlendMode::Lighten,
445            CompositeMode::ColorDodge => BlendMode::ColorDodge,
446            CompositeMode::ColorBurn => BlendMode::ColorBurn,
447            CompositeMode::HardLight => BlendMode::HardLight,
448            CompositeMode::SoftLight => BlendMode::SoftLight,
449            CompositeMode::Difference => BlendMode::Difference,
450            CompositeMode::Exclusion => BlendMode::Exclusion,
451            CompositeMode::Multiply => BlendMode::Multiply,
452            CompositeMode::HslHue => BlendMode::Hue,
453            CompositeMode::HslColor => BlendMode::Color,
454            CompositeMode::HslLuminosity => BlendMode::Luminosity,
455            CompositeMode::HslSaturation => BlendMode::Saturation,
456            _ => BlendMode::Normal,
457        };
458
459        self.layers.push(mode);
460        self.stack.push(vec![]);
461    }
462
463    fn pop_layer(&mut self) {
464        let (Some(blend), Some(instructions)) = (self.layers.pop(), self.stack.pop()) else {
465            self.error = true;
466            return;
467        };
468
469        let Some(stack) = self.stack.last_mut() else {
470            self.error = true;
471            return;
472        };
473
474        stack.push(Instruction::Layer(blend, instructions));
475    }
476}
